remarks: Discover this beautifully updated townhouse offering the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. The thoughtfully designed interior spans 1,666 square feet, featuring two well-proportioned bedrooms and one and a half bathrooms. The finished basement provides valuable additional living space, perfect for a home office, entertainment area, or storage. Located on a peaceful cul-de-sac, this home benefits from excellent community amenities, including proximity to the Norwalk River Valley Trail for outdoor enthusiasts. The attached one-car garage offers protected parking and extra storage space. Public transportation is easily accessible, with both train and bus stations within a mile radius. The property's modern updates enhance everyday living while maintaining its timeless appeal. Urban conveniences and natural surroundings create an ideal setting for this welcoming residence in a sought-after neighborhood.
